packets.title: 7 Days Costa Rica Itinerary | Costa Rica with Kids
packets.summary: Hailey Terry's own day-by-day 7-day Costa Rica family itinerary (Feb 2024): San Jose arrival, La Fortuna (Arenal Volcano NP, hot springs, La Fortuna Waterfall, Ecoglide zipline), drive via Jaco to Manuel Antonio (mangrove wildlife tour, Espadilla Beach); Airbnb stays.

items.name: Red-eye flight to San Jose
items.details: Las Vegas-Los Angeles-San Jose overnight; USO lounge during delay.

items.name: Airbnb in La Fortuna
items.details: Family Airbnb with small pool/hot tub; grocery stop at Super El Abuelo.

items.name: Drive San Jose to La Fortuna
items.details: ~3 hr drive after rental car pickup; dinner at Rainforest Cafe.

items.name: Arenal Volcano National Park hike
items.details: Las Coladas trail to lava-rock viewpoint; leaf-cutter ants.

items.name: Free natural hot springs
items.details: Riverside hot springs next to Tabacon Resort; water shoes recommended.

items.name: La Fortuna Waterfall
items.details: $20/adult, kids under 8 free; opens 7am, go early; long stair descent.

items.name: Ecoglide zipline
items.details: Family zipline; kids rode with guides; group of ~15.

items.name: Drive La Fortuna to Manuel Antonio via Jaco
items.details: Long drive day; beach stop at Jaco; steep-driveway Airbnb in Manuel Antonio.

items.name: Manuel Antonio rest day
items.details: Church, infinity pool, lunch at Soda Angel, beach, Falafel Bar dinner.

items.name: Mangrove wildlife boat tour
items.details: Early boat tour: lizards, turtles, monkeys, sloth.

items.name: Espadilla Beach sunset
items.details: Sunset beach time; surfboard rental attempt.

packets.title: Southern Idaho Road Trip: Best Way to See Various Landscapes
packets.summary: Katie Williams' own 10-day Southern Idaho road-trip itinerary (updated ~2026-08-04): Days 1-2 Boise (downtown food scene, Greenbelt, Boise River float), Day 3 Bruneau Sand Dunes + Big Idaho Potato Hotel, Day 4 Thousand Springs (Blue Heart Springs kayak), Day 5 Twin Falls (Shoshone Falls, Snake River Canyon), Day 6 City of Rocks, Day 7 Craters of the Moon, Days 8-9 Sun Valley/Ketchum, Day 10 Stanley/Redfish Lake/Sawtooth National Forest; stay recommendations with booking/affiliate links.

items.name: Downtown Boise food and bars
items.details: 8th Street restaurants, 6th Street bar scene; favorite breakfast/coffee spots.

items.name: Boise Greenbelt bike ride and river float
items.details: Bike the Greenbelt, float the Boise River in summer, end at local breweries.

items.name: Bruneau Dunes State Park
items.details: Sandboarding, hiking the dunes, Bruneau Dunes Observatory stargazing.

items.name: Big Idaho Potato Hotel
items.details: Funky Airbnb in the famous potato; feed Dolly the cow on-site.

items.name: Thousand Springs Reserve and Blue Heart Springs
items.details: Kayak to Blue Heart Springs and Ritter Island; summer camping.

items.name: 1000 Springs Resort
items.details: Camping spots on the water; geothermal mineral pool.

items.name: Shoshone Falls and Twin Falls
items.details: Shoshone Falls Park viewpoints, Snake River Canyon, downtown dining.

items.name: City of Rocks National Reserve
items.details: 49-mile scenic drive, bouldering, camping, stargazing.

items.name: Craters of the Moon National Monument
items.details: Lava flows and cinder cones; North Crater Trail hike (3.5 mi).

items.name: Sun Valley and Ketchum
items.details: Bald Mountain skiing in winter, hiking/biking in summer; restaurant and bar scene.

items.name: Hotel Ketchum
items.details: Recommended boutique hotel in a great location.

items.name: Stanley, Redfish Lake, Sawtooth National Forest
items.details: Redfish Lake camping/hiking, Alice Toxaway backpacking loop, Bridalveil Falls hike (7.3 mi).

packets.title: The Ultimate Kuala Lumpur Itinerary
packets.summary: Adil Musa's Kuala Lumpur guide from his Malaysia trip: recommends 2-3 days covering Jalan Alor food street, Warisan Merdeka Tower, Petronas Twin Towers, Thean Hou Temple, Jamek Masjid, Sultan Abdul Samad Building, Petaling Street, KL Forest Eco Park.

items.name: Jalan Alor Food Street Market
items.details: Vibrant evening food street; satay, grilled fish, noodles, cendol; near Bukit Bintang hotels.

items.name: Warisan Merdeka Tower
items.details: 644m skyscraper, one of Malaysia's tallest; modern architecture icon; seen on train to Little India.

items.name: Petronas Twin Towers
items.details: Iconic 88-storey towers; Suria KLCC Mall below; Dancing Lake Symphony Fountain Show after 7:30pm.

items.name: Thean Hou Temple
items.details: Chinese temple with garden; creator explored and photographed.

items.name: Jamek Masjid
items.details: One of city's oldest mosques (1909); Moorish/Islamic design, domes and minarets; near Sultan Abdul Building.

items.name: Sultan Abdul Samad Building
items.details: Historic landmark building photographed by creator.

items.name: Petaling Street Market
items.details: Vibrant market; local delicacies, apparel, souvenirs; bargaining expected; neon nightlife after sunset.

items.name: KL Forest Eco Park
items.details: Urban rainforest sanctuary; canopy walkway, monkeys, birds; minutes from KL Tower.
